messages:
oliver: Postmortem synthesis sprint: we need concrete runbook/playbook edits from the 3/15 incident. Goals: (A) tighten triage steps + commands, (B) remove escalation ambiguity, (C) assign remediation owners with ETA, (D) add a short recurring probe to catch the eviction ramp. Volunteers?
samira: I can own A (triage steps). Ill add exact kubectl/prom queries and a one-line reproducible check. Will include a small validation checklist for drills.
ben-oncall: Ill take B (escalation). There was confusion about paging infra vs platform during cross-pool pressure. Ill add a 3-step flow + RACI and a 2-minute page-ack fallback to autodial.
tanvi: Ill take ownership of C (remediation items). Ill break larger remediation into M1/M2 tasks and propose dates. Also suggest an owner-ping cadence (7d, 14d) for open items.
product-ops: Ill review anything customer-facing and draft a short comms blurb if needed. Also want a flag in the playbook for "customer-visible" items.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-6220: "Synthesis sprint - runbook & playbook updates" assigned to samira, ben-oncall, tanvi. Due 2025-04-09.
infra-bot: Linked INF-6220 -> INF-6221 (add canary probe) and INF-6222 (runbook-lint CI).
samira: Example triage snippets Ill add:
```sh
# pods showing eviction events
kubectl get events --all-namespaces --field-selector reason=Evicted -o json | jq '.items[] | {ns:.metadata.namespace, pod:.involvedObject.name, msg:.message}'
# eviction rate by pool (Prometheus)
curl -s "$PROM/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool)"
```
ben-oncall: Canary probe YAML Ill propose in the playbook:
```yaml
readinessProbe:
  exec:
    command: ["/bin/sh","-c","curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health || exit 2"]
  periodSeconds: 30
  failureThreshold: 3
```
tanvi: My plan for remediation owners: split into quick fixes (M1, 2w) and longer platform changes (M2, 8w). Ill assign owners and publish dates in INF-6220 by EOD tomorrow. Also adding owner reminder workflow (7/14 days).
product-ops: Please mark any item I should surface externally with `customer-visible: true`. Ill prepare a standard blurb template.
ops-bot: Subtasks created: INF-6221 (canary probe) assigned to infra team, INF-6222 (runbook-lint CI) assigned to devex.
oliver: Recap: samira -> triage PR (include validation checklist) by EOD tomorrow; ben-oncall -> escalation + RACI in 3 days; tanvi -> remediation owner list + dates by EOD tomorrow; product-ops -> comms review. Schedule a 2-week verification drill after changes land. Thanks everyone.
